visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young man with black-rimmed glasses and a black baseball cap stands on an outdoor urban sidewalk shaded by green trees. He holds a wooden skewer with three glistening, golden-brown fried dough balls coated in sesame seeds. He speaks directly to the camera with an enthusiastic expression, while a red food stall sign is partially visible in the background. (2) The camera moves into a tight close-up as the man opens his mouth wide to take a large bite of the top dough ball. His facial expression is exaggeratedly surprised, with his eyes widening and rolling upward to convey delight at the snack's taste and texture. (3) The man continues to chew and talk, gesturing with the skewer. A small white emoji of a surprised face with dots for eyes appears as a floating graphic next to his head. The background shows a typical city street with parked cars and pedestrians in the distance. (4) A second young man with glasses and a black shirt appears, also eating the same snack. He nods approvingly toward the camera. The scene then shifts to a close-up of a worker's hands in a food stall, placing small portions of minced meat onto long strips of pale dough on a metal counter. (5) The footage shows the cooking process at the stall, where the dough is rolled into spirals and flattened by hand. These discs are then placed onto a large, dark circular griddle to be shallow-fried until golden. The environment is a busy street-side kitchen with various metal utensils and cooking surfaces. (6) A camera shot looks inside a traditional deep-well oven where several flatbreads are stuck to the hot inner walls, baking. A pair of metal tongs reaches in to flip one of the breads, which has turned a deep crispy brown. (7) A close-up shot reveals a partially eaten flatbread (Guokui) held in a hand, showing the multiple flaky, crispy layers of the crust and the savory meat filling inside. The man with the cap returns to the frame, taking a satisfied bite of this second snack and winking at the camera while chewing. (8) The video concludes with a static shot of the red and white shop sign titled 'Chengdu Famous Snack,' which lists the names and prices of various items including the dough balls and different meat-filled flatbreads.
